summary: MCP server 3: phase 0L, define _DEBUG in Linux Debug builds (needs user go-ahead)
author: pm
body:
Add `$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:_DEBUG>` on HelbreathClient in the client CMake. This wakes 18 existing `#ifdef _DEBUG` client sites on Linux for the first time (updater skip, DebugConsole, profiling; measured count). Do not start without the user's go-ahead. 1 file, ~3 lines.

**Done when:** the user has approved; a WSL Debug build compiles and runs with the 18 sites active; reviewed.

Source: plan `.claude/design/plans/client-agent-mcp.md` (HH-0033, reviewed 2026-11-24); decisions d-027, d-028.

**User go-ahead, 2026-11-24:** "Approve HH-0036".

**Closed, 2026-11-24:** read-only review passed. WSL `build_client_linux.sh debug nodeploy` exit 0, 0 `warning:` lines, `-D_DEBUG` in `flags.make` (measured); the deployed Linux Debug client ran 45 s to the timeout (exit 124) with no crash (measured). Not exercised: the woken debug paths themselves (tile grid, spell overlay, logout countdown, teleport messages); checked by reading only. Behaviour now matching Windows Debug: the Linux Debug client targets 127.0.0.1 (`global_def.h:25`) and skips the update check (`wmain.cpp:20`).
